data.one_liner: A customizable bottom navigation bar with various animated styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of ready‑made bottom bar widgets with multiple visual styles and animation options. You define TabItem entries and choose a style, then the widget handles selection and animation.
use_when: You need a visually rich bottom navigation bar with built‑in animations
You want multiple pre‑designed styles (hexagon, circle, creative, etc.) without writing custom code
avoid_when: A simple static BottomNavigationBar is sufficient
You require platform‑specific navigation logic or deep‑link handling
strengths: Easy to integrate with just a few lines of code
Supports custom colors and layout tweaks
weaknesses: Documentation is limited to screenshots and a basic example
Only focuses on bottom navigation, no other UI components
Potential bugs in some styles (e.g., floating creative click issue)
